plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Review GitHub PRs awaiting my review: list them as a table, analyze with full local context, and submit approve/request-changes/comment after explicit confirmation.

plugins.name: vault-ssh
plugins.description: Sign a local SSH key with HashiCorp Vault's SSH CA to mint a short-lived (1 day) SSH certificate. Reads credentials from ~/.vaultrc, auto-detects the key (suggesting the default) and signer role, and drops the cert next to the key. Use proactively when an SSH connection fails on a missing/expired certificate.
